propositions: Attested evidence lacking measurement provenance fields (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument type) cannot be audited for whether the measurement could have observed the claimed failure.

Live measurements taken under broader privilege than production (wildcard identity, simulator queries) are structurally unable to fail for the reason that matters and generate unverifiable conclusions.
Plans asserting unchanged behavior across configuration swaps while citing no consumer of that configuration hide defects in uncited resolution paths that gates cannot discover.
The completion-verifier must not re-run world measurements to validate them, as its own credentials carry the same privilege-masking problem and would validate using the suspect instrument.
Deterministic text-based enforcement of measurement provenance fields in attested evidence enables repo-grounded tools to find contradictions without requiring gates to observe the world.

The four-field measurement provenance contract (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) must be present and machine-checkable before LLM criteria can judge the declaration against repo facts.
